scope: Selected released opening, crystal-selection and XP methods; five complete reward resources; independent selector examples. No game execution.

selection_examples.name: One eligible skill while others remain1

limits: Lowest skill means lowest displayed eligible level at least15, not lowest skill overall.
The fourth addXp parameter name does not establish that buffs are skipped.
Skills-disabled XP handling can return before the caller shrinks an eligible crystal.
Loot weights, luck and multiple rolls must be interpreted separately.
